resources.string: Props read via getprop · No root / ADB required
🤔\nCurrent device doesn\'t support SSU,\nyou need to insert the SIM card yourself
(Current result might be inaccurate because of Exynos or MTK)

SSU (Service Software Unlock) is Samsung's regional SIM lock temporary unlock mechanism, granted by Samsung to allow a locked device to use SIM cards from a supported region.

⚠️ SSU is NOT permanent. Your device can be re-locked at any time — after an OTA update, factory reset, or remote revocation by Samsung.

SSU only works with SIM cards from the region where the unlock was signed. Using a SIM from an unsupported region may still be blocked.

✅ No SSU / Global Unlocked means your device has no regional SIM lock — it can be freely used with any compatible SIM card.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
📱 ATT (AT&T) Devices — S25 and Earlier

For Samsung devices with Carrier ID = ATT on models before S26 series (e.g. S25, S24, S23...), SSU does not apply. These devices use a different carrier lock mechanism. If you see "ATT Not Recognized", you need to check your unlock status manually through AT&T or Samsung.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🔬 Chip Accuracy Notice

This app's SSU detection is accurate for devices with Snapdragon 8 Gen 4 (SM8650) and newer chips.

For older chips (SM8350, SM8450, SM8550), SSU props may not be present even if the device is locked — you need to insert a foreign SIM card to check manually.

Other chipsets (Exynos, MediaTek) may show inaccurate results. The result will include a warning when this is detected.
